categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Su Da Weige Technology Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily in micro-nano optical manufacturing and reflective materials industries. Its business is organized into four main segments: Public Safety and New 3D Printing Materials, Consumer Electronics New Materials, High-end Intelligent Equipment, and Reflective Materials. The company focuses on micro-nano optical products including security films for official documents, 3D optical printing materials for packaging, optical films for displays, and high-end lithography equipment. Reflective materials include various grades of reflective films and fabrics used in traffic safety and personal protection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary micro-nano optical manufacturing technologies such as laser direct writing lithography and nanoimprint lithography to produce micro-nano structured films and devices. It has developed a modular, knowledge-intensive, upgradeable micro-nano manufacturing platform. Production methods include thermal pressing for ultra-thin light guide plates, physical additive processes for flexible transparent conductive films, and advanced green manufacturing processes eliminating organic solvents. The company also develops and manufactures high-end lithography equipment for research and industrial applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies for public safety document security films, major tobacco, alcohol, cosmetics, and daily chemical companies for packaging materials, leading display panel manufacturers such as BOE, Samsung, LG Display for optical films, and automotive brands for nano-textured interior materials. The company serves markets in public security, consumer electronics, automotive, semiconductor, and emerging AR/VR display sectors. It also targets international customers in Europe and North America, especially for advanced optical and display materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Suzhou and subsidiaries in Jiangsu province. It has expanded overseas sales, successfully acquiring several European and American terminal customers. The company is actively promoting export business and international cooperation, especially in North America and Europe, for its advanced micro-nano optical products and AR-related materials.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suzhou Su Da Weige operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures core micro-nano optical materials and components, develops proprietary lithography equipment, and supplies customized products directly to end customers and OEMs in various industries. The company also engages in upstream R&D and equipment manufacturing, supporting downstream application sectors such as display panel makers, packaging companies, and automotive manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on consolidating and expanding its micro-nano optical manufacturing business while divesting its reflective materials segment. R&D priorities include advancing micro-nano optical anti-counterfeiting materials for national ID cards and tickets, developing high-performance lithography equipment for semiconductor and photonics applications, and innovating in large-size flexible display and touch control materials. It emphasizes green manufacturing, nano-texture materials for automotive interiors, AR/VR display technologies, and expanding international market presence. The company invests heavily in innovation platforms and collaborates with academic and industry partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of micro-nano optical products, reflective materials, and high-end lithography equipment. The company provides customized product development and manufacturing services, especially for security and packaging materials. It also earns income from licensing and technology services related to its proprietary equipment and materials. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels domestically and through distributors internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in micro-nano optical manufacturing with a strong R&D and production platform. In reflective materials, it faces intense competition from multinational corporations like 3M and domestic peers such as Daoming Optical. It holds a unique position as the sole supplier of certain public security anti-counterfeiting films in China. The company is expanding its market share in consumer electronics optical materials and high-end lithography equipment, competing with global technology leaders in these fields.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.72 billion, a slight increase of 0.4% year-over-year. Despite operating losses, net losses narrowed significantly compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets were about RMB 3.12 billion at year-end, with a net asset base of approximately RMB 1.66 billion. It has experienced fluctuations due to market cycles and is focusing on improving profitability by divesting non-core businesses and expanding high-value product lines. R&D investment remains robust at over 8% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary micro-nano optical manufacturing technologies and integrated production platform as key differentiators. It offers highly customized, advanced anti-counterfeiting materials with unique optical effects, green and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, and high-performance optical films for displays and touch controls. Its exclusive position in public security document films and innovative 3D optical printing materials for packaging provide strong competitive advantages. The company’s vertically integrated capabilities from equipment development to product manufacturing enable rapid innovation and quality control, supporting its leadership in niche high-tech optical materials markets.
